tldr: September JOLTS blew past consensus (7.52M vs 7.15M) on top of October's hot ISM (55.5), pushing convergent Polymarket/Kalshi/CME odds of a December Fed HIKE to ~73% -- the hawkish-repricing regime from yesterday just deepened, not reversed.

US midterm results were still uncalled as of this run (07:02 SGT = ~18:02 ET election night); pre-close markets priced a likely Dem House/GOP Senate and equities closed calmly (S&P +0.36%, VIX -1.5%), but CNBC flagged real contested-results risk -- don't trade a 'gridlock relief' rally as settled yet.
Monday's Hormuz oil crash stalled Tuesday (Brent -0.33%, WTI +0.31%) after Iran said the strait stays closed pending US sanctions relief -- the de-escalation story is not confirmed, it's paused.

China's rare-earth export-control truce (Announcement No. 70) is 6 days from its Nov 10 legal expiry with still no superseding text published -- the single highest-conviction near-term catalyst for the MP/Lynas/UUUU/USAR watchlist.

Wing Tai's Chairman kept buying via his spouse almost daily through early November (1.13M shares since Oct 21, deemed stake now ~63.86%) -- no price was ever disclosed on any of the 9 filings, so none is published here.

Fear & Greed fell to 19 (Extreme Fear), its first back-to-back extreme-fear close, even as breadth quietly improved (63.4% of S&P above its 200-DMA, up from 59.4% four sessions ago) -- a genuinely split tape, not a clean risk-off signal.
